brief: REPAIR: the start scene is a forehand bat swing blocked from words that moves the bat like a twig (33 m/s at the tip); give the bat its weight so the WEAPON judge passes, and keep the tip landing on the target's head.
notes: The start is the whole raw swing (TextBlocking.build 'forehand bat swing'). WEAPON (scripts/weapon_torque.gd) flags it: about 336 N m at the wrist against a measured 14.9 N m maximum. Slowing the swing (torque goes as 1/T^2), a wind-up and an overshoot are the usual repairs. The contact time is free; the tip must touch the head somewhere in the clip.

asserts.line: weapon tip touches fighter 2 head at 2.07 s +-30 f
weapon tip speed under 12 m/s all clip
